subject: history
concept: Understanding the Industrial Revolution as a major shift from hand-made goods to machine production
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares a hand-crafting process to a simplified machine-production version of the same item
exercise.pictorial: Student sequences pictures showing the shift from home workshops to factories
exercise.abstract: Student explains one way the Industrial Revolution changed how goods were made

misconception_flags: confuses the Industrial Revolution with a political revolution rather than an economic/technological shift

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
